summary.result: Comparisons of the calculated results, for the elasto-viscoplastic analysis of an internally pressurised thick cylinder under plane strain condition, have shown that the model yields excellent results.
summary.background: In the study of structural components under static loading conditions at normal temperature it is accepted that time rate effects are generally not important.
summary.method: In this study, elastoplastic and elasto-viscoplastic models include nonlinear geometrical effects were developed and several numerical examples are also included to verify the computer programming work developed here in this work.
